segments.name: Urban mobility platform
segments.description: Türkiye's leading urban mobility super app offering ride-hailing, same-hour delivery, and shared two-wheeled electric vehicle services to consumers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and reports as a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Consumers pay subscription package fees for platform benefits and pay per-trip rental fees, based on minutes and a starting fare, to rent two-wheeled electric vehicles.
revenueModel.evidence: Our two-wheeled electric vehicles revenue is primarily generated from the fees paid by our consumers to rent our vehicles less promotions, discounts, and refunds.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company combined its two previously reported segments, Two-wheeled Electric Vehicle and Ride-hailing, into a single operating and reportable segment.
changes.evidence: Prior to December 31, 2024, the Company reported two separate operating segments: (i) Two-wheeled Electric Vehicle and (ii) Ride-hailing.
